```lean
theorem lg_target (a : ℤ) : a ^ 2 % 4 = 0 ∨ a ^ 2 % 4 = 1 := by
  rcases Int.eq_zero_or_pos_or_neg a with (| | |)
  · rw [pow_two, mod_eq_mod_of_divides]
    exact dvd_zero
  · rw [pow_two, mod_eq_mod_of_divides]
    exact (dvd_add (dvd_mul_right (dvd_two n) 2) (dvd_two n)).dvd_mod
  · rw [pow_two, mod_eq_mod_of_divides]
    exact (dvd_add (dvd_mul_right (dvd_two (-n)) 2) (dvd_two (-n))).dvd_mod
```
